title: pt2 torch version gate must stay in sync with the pickle-free docs and test skips
answers: which torch version is needed to load pt2 models with pickle disabled
change the minimum torch version for pt2 weights_only validation
pt2 docs say torch 2.4 but load fails with pickle disabled
body:
Invariant: the torch version gate in mlflow/pytorch/__init__.py:_validate_pt2_archive_is_pickle_free (Version < 2.10, citing CVE-2025-32434 and CVE-2026-24747) must match the documented loading requirement and the test gates.
Enforced in: that gate raises MlflowException asking to upgrade torch or enable the flag; the pt2 requirements box in docs/docs/classic-ml/tracking/pickle-free-models/index.mdx states torch >= 2.10 to load under the hardened setting.
What breaks if skipped: docs advertising torch >= 2.4 mislead users whose pt2 loads then fail; a lower gate would admit weights_only versions with known bypass or memory-corruption issues.
Keep in sync: tests/pytorch/test_pytorch_model_export.py pt2 guard tests skip below 2.10, and the unverifiable-torch test patches torch.__version__ to 2.9.1 and matches 'Upgrade to `torch` >= 2.10'.
applies: Changing the torch version floor, the pt2 load guard message, or the pickle-free models guide for PyTorch.
says: Documentation claims earlier PyTorch versions work, but secure model loading demands a newer version.
Loading safe PyTorch exported models fails with version errors that contradict published documentation.
Update model security documentation because stated minimum PyTorch versions fail to load exported models.
Secure model loading rejects supported PyTorch installations despite meeting documented system requirements.
search: The torch version gate in mlflow/pytorch/__init__.py:_validate_pt2_archive_is_pickle_free requiring torch >= 2.10 must stay synchronized with documentation in docs/docs/classic-ml/tracking/pickle-free-models/index.mdx and test gates in tests/pytorch/test_pytorch_model_export.py. The gate cites CVE-2025-32434 and CVE-2026-24747 and raises MlflowException asking to upgrade torch or enable the flag. This applies when changing the torch version floor, pt2 load guard error messages, or the pickle-free models guide, with tests skipping below 2.10 and patching torch.__version__ to 2.9.1 to match the upgrade message.
